projects.title: CRM — SR Enterprises
projects.shortDescription: End-to-end custom enterprise CRM platform built for high-throughput customer data management and automated operational workflows.
projects.fullDescription: Production-grade CRM platform engineered to replace fragmented spreadsheets and manual administrative tasks. Built with 11 core modules managing 2,000–3,000+ verified customer records with role-based access control, workflow automation, and relational data integrity.
projects.problem: Operational bottlenecks from manual customer record tracking across spreadsheets, risking record loss and slow retrieval latency during peak business inquiries.
projects.objective: Architect a high-performance, centralized CRM platform supporting multi-module operations, role-based security, and sub-second record access.
projects.solution: Engineered a modular full-stack web application with React and Node.js REST APIs backed by PostgreSQL relational schemas and automated audit trails.
projects.architectureSummary: Client-server architecture with React frontend, stateless Node.js REST API layer, and normalized PostgreSQL relational database.
implementation: Architected 11 core enterprise modules including customer directory, lead pipeline, communication logs, and billing workflows
Implemented strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) separating administrative and operational staff permissions
Engineered indexed PostgreSQL queries for instantaneous customer record searching and filtering
Designed responsive mobile-ready interface enabling field staff access across all device form factors
decisions: Chosen PostgreSQL for relational ACID transactions and strict schema integrity over unconstrained documents
Implemented normalized relational schemas to prevent data anomalies across customer and transaction tables
Adopted stateless REST API patterns for reliable horizontal scaling
challenges: Migrating legacy unformatted spreadsheets into a normalized relational schema without data loss
Enforcing role-based authorization guards across 11 interconnected modules
impact: Approximately 90% faster customer record retrieval compared to legacy spreadsheet searching
Approximately 65% reduction in manual data entry through workflow automation
Approximately 90% lower risk of record loss and duplicate data entries

media.caption: CRM — SR Enterprises Operational Dashboard & Customer Pipeline

projects.title: Inventory Management Platform
projects.shortDescription: High-throughput inventory control and stock tracking enterprise application with automated workflows and audit logging.
projects.fullDescription: Enterprise-grade inventory platform engineered to manage 1,000+ active SKUs and 10,000+ historical stock transactions. Built with Python, FastAPI, React, and PostgreSQL, featuring 20+ automated business workflows including purchase/sales pipelines, stock adjustments, invoice generation, low-stock notifications, and inventory analytics.
projects.problem: Warehouse inventory counts suffered discrepancy and stockout incidents caused by manual tracking, slow catalog search, and lack of transaction-level audit logs.
projects.objective: Build an automated inventory tracking solution with high-frequency stock reconciliation, automated reorder thresholds, and low-latency catalog search.
projects.solution: Engineered a reactive full-stack platform using React and Python FastAPI with PostgreSQL transaction management and automated threshold alerts.
projects.architectureSummary: FastAPI asynchronous microservice architecture with PostgreSQL relational persistence, indexed SKU catalogs, and automated workflow triggers.
implementation: Engineered 20+ automated inventory workflows including purchase order processing, sales tracking, and stock reconciliations
Designed catalog indexing supporting instant filtering across 1,000+ active SKUs
Implemented automated low-stock alerting triggers to prevent operational stockouts
Built automated invoice generation and transactional audit trails
decisions: Selected Python FastAPI for asynchronous I/O performance and native OpenAPI documentation
Enforced strict database transaction boundaries to prevent concurrent stock decrement race conditions
Implemented relational audit logging for every SKU adjustment
challenges: Handling concurrent stock adjustments during peak warehouse fulfillment without inventory count drift
Optimizing multi-criteria SKU queries across large transaction histories
impact: Approximately 80–90% faster stock retrieval across entire catalog
Approximately 70% fewer manual warehouse operational steps
Approximately 75% fewer stock-entry errors through automated validation

media.caption: StockManager Enterprise Inventory Dashboard & Warehouse Analytics

projects.title: Campus Buddy – AI Campus Management System
projects.shortDescription: AI-powered campus platform with timetable management, event notifications, admin workflows, and 24/7 student chatbot.
projects.fullDescription: Engineered an AI-powered campus management platform with automated timetable scheduling, event notifications, administrative workflows, and a 24/7 interactive student inquiry chatbot powered by Google Gemini API. Built as a rapid prototype in under 2 weeks with ~60% build time reduction.
projects.problem: Fragmented student scheduling, manual announcement distribution, and delayed administrative inquiry resolution across campus departments.
projects.objective: Unify campus schedules and automate student inquiry workflows with an AI conversational assistant and administrative broadcasting tools.
projects.solution: Integrated Next.js and TypeScript frontend with Gemini API conversational assistant, responsive scheduling calendars, and notification channels.
projects.architectureSummary: Next.js App Router full-stack web application integrated with Google Gemini API for generative AI conversational inquiry processing.
implementation: Integrated Google Gemini API for 24/7 automated student query resolution with domain-tailored prompt engineering
Created modular timetable scheduling calendar with responsive course views
Implemented administrative broadcast notification channels for immediate campus alert distribution
decisions: Used Gemini API with structured system prompts to guarantee factual timetable and inquiry responses without hallucinations
Adopted Next.js App Router for rapid component-driven delivery within a 2-week prototyping deadline
challenges: Structuring prompt context window to ensure accurate schedule answers within token constraints
impact: Delivered complete operational prototype in under 2 weeks
Approximately 60% reduction in prototyping build time
24/7 automated inquiry support for student body
